# our_phoneme: # Each of our phonemes maps to the symbols espeak-ng -v ne uses for the same sound (checked with
# espeak-ng --ipa per letter), so our output and espeak's can be aligned and mixed (tts/hybrid.py).
# The speaker (tts/kokoro_voice.py) reads these as IPA; it relabels c ɟ as ʦ ʣ.
# A key starting with ˈ gives the vowel written after the stress mark (ʌ -> ˈʌ, not ˈə);
# if absent, ˈ + the plain form is used.
# Everything is NFD-normalized on load, so ã may be typed precomposed.
